title: 맵다, 듣다, 짓다: 받침이 바뀌는 말 쓰기
objective: By the end, you can change ㅂ, ㄷ and ㅅ irregular words into the 해요 form and the past form. You can also tell them apart from regular words that look the same, like 입어요, 닫아요 and 씻어요.
summary: Learn how ㅂ, ㄷ and ㅅ at the end of some verb and adjective stems change before -아요/어요, like 매워요, 들어요 and 지어요.

task.title: Change the words correctly
task.line: Use the rules and the table to write or choose the correct form of each word.

forms.when: Some stems that end in ㅂ (many of them adjectives): 맵다, 춥다, 덥다, 쉽다, 어렵다
forms.means: ㅂ becomes 우, and 우 + 어요 = 워요. 맵다 → 매워요
forms.exampleMeaning: This kimchi is a bit spicy.

forms.means: Here ㅂ becomes 오, and 오 + 아요 = 와요.
forms.exampleMeaning: Mom is cooking. I help her.

forms.when: Some verbs that end in ㄷ: 듣다, 걷다, 묻다 (to ask)
forms.means: Before a vowel, ㄷ becomes ㄹ. 듣다 → 들어요, 걷다 → 걸어요
forms.exampleMeaning: I listen to music in the morning.

forms.when: Some words that end in ㅅ: 짓다 (to make, to build), 낫다 (to get better)
forms.means: Before a vowel, ㅅ drops. The two vowels do not join together. 짓다 → 지어요, 낫다 → 나아요

forms.when: The past tense also starts with a vowel.
forms.means: The same changes happen. 맵다 → 매웠어요, 듣다 → 들었어요, 낫다 → 나았어요
forms.exampleMeaning: The tteokbokki was too spicy yesterday.

forms.when: 입다, 좁다, 받다, 닫다, 웃다, 씻다
forms.means: These end in ㅂ, ㄷ or ㅅ too, but they do not change. 입다 → 입어요, 받다 → 받아요
forms.exampleMeaning: I got flowers on my birthday.

watchOut: 맵어요 (X) → 매워요 (O): In ㅂ irregular words, ㅂ becomes 우 before -어요.
도워요 (X) → 도와요 (O): 돕다 takes 와요, not 워요.
져요 (X) → 지어요 (O): After ㅅ drops, do not join the vowels. 낫다 is the same: 나아요.
입워요 (X) → 입어요 (O): Some words do not change. 입다, 좁다, 받다, 닫다, 웃다 and 씻다 are regular. Learn them one by one.
더워고 (X) → 덥고 (O): Before an ending that starts with a consonant, like -고 or -지만, keep the stem as it is: 덥고, 듣고, 짓지만.
exercises: Write the 해요 form of the word in brackets: ① 오늘은 날씨가 정말 ____. (춥다) ② 이 문제는 아주 ____. (쉽다)
Write the 해요 form of the word in brackets. Be careful: two words are regular. ① 길을 몰라요. 경찰에게 길을 ____. (묻다) ② 추워요. 창문을 ____. (닫다) ③ 손을 ____. (씻다) ④ 저녁에 밥을 ____. (짓다)
Choose the correct word: 감기가 다 (나았어요 / 낫았어요 / 났어요).
Choose the correct word: ① 가방이 너무 (무거워요 / 무겁어요). ② 오늘은 청바지를 (입어요 / 입워요). ③ 아기가 (웃어요 / 우어요).
Write the past form (-았어요/었어요) of the word in brackets: ① 어제 공원에서 오래 ____. (걷다) ② 지난 주말에 친구를 ____. (돕다)
Join the two sentences with -고: ① 집이 가까워요. + 집이 커요. → 집이 ____ 커요. ② 공원에서 걸어요. + 공원에서 커피를 마셔요. → 공원에서 ____ 커피를 마셔요.
answers: ① 물어요 ② 닫아요 ③ 씻어요 ④ 지어요
① 무거워요 ② 입어요 ③ 웃어요
